title: Vibe Deck JSON widget
description: A widget made only of JSON: a shape, where the data comes from, what to show and what a tap does. File: <plugin>/widgets/<name>.json.

template.description: Text with placeholders filled by the PC: {{field.sub}}, also with filters: {{x|round:1}}, {{x|percent}}, {{x|bytes}}, {{x|duration}}, {{x|ago}}, {{x|upper}}, {{x|lower}}, {{x|default:-}}, {{x|yesno:on:off}}, {{x|url}}, {{x|count}}, {{x|map:table}}, {{x|zip}}, {{x|first}}, {{x|join:, }}, {{x|date}} / date:day / date:weekday / date:time.

action.description: Same actions as the page buttons (launch, hotkey, key, text, media, open_url, open_path, command, macro, plugin actions). Strings can use {{placeholders}}.

id.description: Optional: must be the file name without .json.

name.description: Name in the HOME catalog of the control panel.

shape.description: value = big number; bars = rows with bars; status = dot + text; text = free text; buttons = grid of buttons; voice = voice commands and dictation; list = rows from a list in the data; slider = a value to drag (needs set).

anyOf.description: A source of this plugin (<plugin>.<name>), e.g. audio.mixer.

type.description: pc = data of the PC (cpu, gpu, ram, net, uptimeSeconds, hostname, apps.<id>); static = the "data" written here; http = JSON from a public address listed in permissions.http of plugin.json (every 30 s at most); file = a JSON or text file inside data/; command = output of a command in commands.json. Text that is not JSON becomes { text, lines }.

id.description: command: id of the command in commands.json.

every.description: Seconds between updates (each source has its own minimum).

icon.description: value, text, status, slider: icon or picture (sun, partly, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, showers, snow, storm, moon, or any icon name); can change with the data, e.g. {{code|map:icons}}.

level.description: Number compared with warn/hot (default: the bar or the value).

item.description: list: what each row shows; use {{item.field}}, {{index}}, {{root.field}}.

icon.description: Icon on the left of the row.

max.description: list: rows shown (1-50, default 20). slider: maximum value.

empty.description: list: text when there are no rows.

tap.description: Action on tap. In a list it runs for the tapped row ({{item.field}}).

maps.description: Tables for the map filter: { "weather": { "0": "Clear", "*": "other" } } and {{code|map:weather}}.

say.description: Phrases: the longest one found in what was said wins.

action.description: When no command matches: {{text}} is what was said (use {{text|url}} inside links).
